messages:
deploy-bot: Starting fanout deploy -> environment=prod, services=[runtime, api, console], tag=release-2026-03-20-v1.14.2, commit=a1b2c3d4

alex: ack. rolling with stagger 30s between services. change window is now. pinging @maria for console pin guidance.

maria: watching console metrics. if error-rate > 0.5% or p99>450ms we pin console to tag release-2026-03-19-hotfix.

sam: noted. api and runtime good to go. will monitor batching latency after deployment.

deploy-bot: runtime: deploy started -> instance-group=rg-runtime-2, git=a1b2c3d4

op sbot: healthcheck: runtime: OK (200/200), avg latency 68ms

deploy-bot: api: deploy started -> instance-group=rg-api-3, git=a1b2c3d4

jing: seeing a small spike in api prep containers, but should be transient.

deploy-bot: api: deploy success -> instances=24, rollout_time=95s

opsbot: alert: console healthchecks failing (502) in us-west-2 after new pods came up, 6/8 pods unhealthy

alex: @maria @sam immediate: pause console rollout. please run pin if we don't recover in 3m.

maria: running rollback pin command now: ```./deployctl pin --service console --env prod --tag release-2026-03-19-hotfix --reason "post-deploy 502 spike"```

deploy-bot: console: rollout paused by user alex.

deploy-bot: console: pin applied -> pinned_tag=release-2026-03-19-hotfix, triggered_by=maria

sam: confirm api/runtime unaffected. starting canary traffic back to runtime single AZ to validate KV cache behavior.

opsbot: console pod logs snippet: ```ERROR http: upstream timeout connecting to model-server: context deadline exceeded```

jing: that looks like a model-server side transient. ops team notified and investigating.

alex: thanks. schedule a follow-up postmortem if ops confirms infra root cause. For now we rollforward api/runtime and keep console pinned.

deploy-bot: summary -> runtime: success, api: success, console: pinned->release-2026-03-19-hotfix (pause), actions=[ops-investigate, postmortem], change_window=immediate

maria: added release-note entry in the changelog: "console pinned to previous stable due to 502s during new pod warmup; investigation ongoing"

sam: thumbs up. I'll watch cost and latency dashboards for next 2 hours.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished for fanout id=wf-20260320-07, overall_status=partial (console pinned). logs=/var/log/deploys/wf-20260320-07.log
